reviews.title: Real talk!
reviews.comment: Heyhey my name is Toji am a big gamer/programmer about this pc now->.  Stunning "Aquarium" Aesthetics on a Budget! I am absolutely obsessed with this case! If you want that high-end, wrap-around glass look without spending a fortune, this is the one. It looks like a premium showpiece once it’s all lit up. The Build & Cable Management Setting everything up was surprisingly easy. The cable management was a breeze for the most part, but I do have one major tip for future builders: • The USB 3.0 Challenge: The USB 3.0 cable is quite thick and can get in the way of the bottom fans. • The Fix: I actually removed all the fans to properly route the thicker cables through the back of the case instead. • The Result: It makes the internal chamber look much cleaner (check the pic!). It was well worth the extra few minutes of effort to get that "floating" look for the components. Pros: • Insane Value: Comes with almost all the fans you need (just one short of a full set!). • Easy to Build In: Plenty of room to work and great accessibility. • Top-Tier Aesthetics: The way the fans reflect off the glass panels is beautiful. Final Verdict: If you want a cool-looking PC for a great price, buy this case. Just be prepared to do a little extra routing for the thicker cables to keep it looking perfect!

reviews.title: Built My Son a Gaming PC… Accidentally Built a Disco
reviews.comment: Bought the ANSAITE ATX PC Case with 7 PWM ARGB Fans for my son’s gaming PC build and I’m honestly impressed. The case has plenty of room to work in and the infinity fans look awesome. Once we powered everything on, the RGB lighting was so bright his room looked like a small nightclub. We added a separate RGB controller to customize everything and now the lighting effects are even better. Airflow seems great, the case feels solid, and everything installed easily. My son loves it, which means the build was a success and I’m still the household IT hero for now. Great case and definitely recommend it if you like RGB builds.
reviews.author: Josh Frensley

reviews.title: A great case at a superior price!
reviews.comment: I managed to snag a 5070TI before the prices explode and it wouldn't fit in my old case.  So, after some shopping around I found this one and really liked the look.  The case design is awesome and while some folks were saying the build quality felt cheap, it feels good to me.  I've had way flimsier cases before.  I loved that the fans were pre-installed, so all I had to do was wedge in my components and off she went!  I didn't do a great job on the cable management but I was in a hurry.  I'll go back and clean it up later.  Even slightly messy, it still looks fantastic!
reviews.author: Shea B.

reviews.title: Case is good- arrived with some damage.
reviews.comment: I'm an experienced PC builder who's built multiple PCs for myself and others. The case looks great and I expect some amazing airflow from it, but I was quite disappointed to find a noticeable dent on the back-top of the case, as well as a smaller "inverted" dent at the mid-top of the case. I will be reaching out to customer service in hopes of resolving it. The case is pretty solid and of decent quality. Unlike how some reviewers had mentioned, the PCIe slot covers in the back do have a threaded screw hole to replace them once snapped off, and the case also included an extra PCIe cover. Everything that really needs "removed" is removed easily and without any problems, though as with most cases, you'll need a screwdriver to initially take off the "hand-tightened" screws. There is plenty of space for most of what you'll ever need to fit, so I'm not too worried about what I'll end up installing. The review will be updated come the install of those parts and the completion of the build. Logistically, there were some things that came off odd or confusing. The manual includes install instructions for fans throughout the case, but fails to include instructions for fans being installed at the bottom of the case. Turns out, you use the hardware included with the case and screw the fans in from the inside of the case, not the outside like you usually would. I purchased extra fans from the seller to match everything, and installed these on the bottom- as seen in the photos. Furthermore, I'd highly recommend NOT powering even the 7 included fans via motherboard and daisy chain, get a SATA fan hub. Pulling that much power from the motherboard is not the best idea, and its probably a good idea for the seller to mention a "fan hub sold separately" for the newer folks who are not aware of this. I'm excited to see the completed build, and hopefully the seller takes these comments into consideration.
reviews.author: Mariella Morelli

reviews.title: Great Case
reviews.comment: Well worth the money since everything works perfectly. It’s nice that it did come with 9 fans, but it was also nice and easy to switch it around a bit. Aesthetically it looks great, and works fine for a i7 12700kf CPU and a 5070 ti GPU. I’d say if you don’t plan on putting in super high end components, these case fans will do the job to keep it cool. Very quiet, and when the fans ramp up it’s not super loud. Overall I’ve had much worse cases, and this one is a keeper in my book.
